subject.title: Org claim: vmware-aiops + vmware-monitor — @kingaiwork lookalikes impersonate @zw008 listings (same pattern as #2966/#3035)

question: Can authorized staff confirm that both `@kingaiwork` skill rows and their dependent records are gone, and that v1.7.7 scans and latest-version promotion now succeed for both legitimate listings?
rationale: Public 404s and an unverified deletion statement cannot establish that destructive production cleanup completed or that the blocked publishing pipeline recovered.

options.title: Verify cleanup, then close
options.body: Inspect both owner-qualified records, rerun the two scans, and close only after v1.7.7 is listed or another current version proves the pipeline recovered.

options.title: Keep open for cleanup
options.body: If either duplicate row or scan failure remains, perform the scoped admin cleanup and preserve this issue as the incident record.

recommendation.title: Verify cleanup, then close
recommendation.body: Inspect both owner-qualified records, rerun the two scans, and close only after v1.7.7 is listed or another current version proves the pipeline recovered.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this person to skill hard deletion, scan repair, and the central skills backend.
